verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents connecting voice agents to phone networks for inbound and outbound calls. The concrete guide shows a Twilio number streaming call audio to your own server, which then bridges it to the Deepgram WebSocket. Telephony therefore depends on a third-party carrier and a self-hosted bridge rather than the Deepgram API itself. Missing for 10: native phone-number provisioning through Deepgram's API, first-party outbound call initiation docs, call control without a Twilio bridge server, independent hands-on corroboration.
